channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Prediction markets and sports betting: How this UK exchange is trying to do both in the U.S.
item.description: Smarkets is entering the U.S. prediction market race but also applying to run as a sportsbook within states amid regulatory uncertainty at the federal level.

item.title: Top U.S. commander acknowledges mental health issues on USS Lincoln
item.description: Cooper's visit and statement come after reports of widespread morale and mental health concerns aboard the Lincoln.

item.title: What the results of a Connecticut congressional primary race may mean for Social Security
item.description: Rep. John Larson of Connecticut, an advocate for expanding Social Security, was ousted in a Democratic primary contest Tuesday.

item.title: Depleted strategic oil reserve nears level that raises concerns about damage to caverns, operations
item.description: The rapid drawdown of the U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve could damage the caverns that store the oil, experts warn.

item.title: Secret outperformer: Dispelling the 'myths' about an unloved stock market
item.description: European markets fly under the radar when compared with larger and more liquid U.S. markets, but Goldman Sachs offered to dispel some of the myths.

item.title: JPMorgan could soon be the first $1 trillion bank. Top analyst Mayo says next stop is $2 trillion
item.description: JPMorgan Chase could soon boast a market value in excess of $1 trillion. Several tailwinds are driving share value, according to Wells Fargo.

item.title: Anthropic revenue reportedly jumps to more than $11.5 billion in second quarter
item.description: The jump in revenue underscores the rapid growth of the Claude chatbot maker as it prepares for a potential blockbuster initial public offering.

item.title: Top Wall Street analysts like these 3 dividend stocks for steady income
item.description: Investors looking for steady income can add dividend-paying energy stocks to their portfolios.

item.title: Between earn-nothing cash, broken long-term bonds, these are the safety trades of 2026 market
item.description: Investors have flocked to short-term investments like ultra-short bond funds in anticipation of a stock market correction and with long-term bonds broken.

item.title: AOC says she's been saving up to freeze her eggs. Here's how much the procedure can cost
item.description: AOC is highlighting the cost of freezing her eggs. Here's what to know about health insurance coverage, state laws and taxes associated with the process.

item.title: I drove Tesla FSD, Rivian Autonomy+ ‘hands-free’ driving systems. Here’s how they compare
item.description: Rivian is trying to catch up to Tesla's "hands-free" capabilities, but with additional safety guardrails that the Elon Musk company doesn't have.

item.title: Lamborghini unveils Revuelto SV, its most powerful production car ever
item.description: Lamborghini's Revuelto SV is a limited-edition V12 hybrid with over 1,050 horsepower, a 2.4-second 0-to-100 kph time and a $741,172 starting price.

item.title: Iran rebuffs Trump's claim over Strait of Hormuz amid report of another ship being struck
item.description: Iran's deputy foreign minister says Hormuz "will remain Iranian" after Trump's claim that the waterway would soon become U.S. territory.

item.title: Tommy John, namesake for a pioneering elbow surgery that saved his career, dead at 83
item.description: On Aug. 8, the New York Yankees released a social media post in which John wrote that he wanted to say goodbye: "I will never forget you."

item.title: Goldman Sachs picks China stocks poised to benefit from a new wave of AI-related hardware exports
item.description: The Wall Street powerhouse notes areas where execution of corporate strategy matters more than macroeconomic trends.

item.title: Four Antonello da Messina works stolen in Renaissance painter's hometown
item.description: The thieves entered the Museo Regionale di Messina late on Saturday, while the town was busy celebrating Assumption Day.

item.title: Nvidia eyes investing $3 billion in SoftBank's SB Energy under OpenAI data center deal, Information says
item.description: The proposed investment ⁠is part of Nvidia's talks with OpenAI ⁠and SB Energy on providing credit support for a panned Ohio data center campus, the report said.

item.title: U.S. to tell partners they must pick sides in AI race with China: Reuters
item.description: The draft letter is addressed to the 35 signatories of a U.S. "AI Opportunity Statement" signed in June.

item.title: Lala is again a tropical storm, sending drenching rain and winds across the Hawaiian islands
item.description: The National Hurricane Center is warning of "life-threatening flooding and mudslides" conditions and predicting up to 25 inches of rain on Hawaii's Big Island.

item.title: Nvidia discloses $21 billion stake in SpaceX at end of second quarter
item.description: Nvidia's stake in SpaceX, which came through an investment in xAI, was worth about $21 billion at the end of the second quarter.

item.title: Inflation moderated as Intel and Nvidia fueled the AI trade in last week's market
item.description: No surprises on inflation and new financing developments in the artificial intelligence trade drove the record-breaking action on Wall Street last week.

item.title: Can a prenup protect you from a partner’s debt?
item.description: A prenup can help clarify who’s responsible for debt during and after marriage, but it has limits.

item.title: The internet's grandma has advice for late bloomers: 'It doesn't all have to be perfect'
item.description: Kim Murstein and Gail Rudnick are the duo behind "Excuse My Grandma," an advice podcast that dives into life, love and other issues across generations.

item.title: Berkshire adds $17 billion to Alphabet stake
item.description: Google parent Alphabet is now the third largest holding in Berkshire Hathaway's equity portfolio.

item.title: Marijuana reform is emerging as a midterm elections issue on both sides of the aisle
item.description: With November's midterms fast approaching, cannabis reform is an issue. It's popular with voters, but its power to tilt elections remains uncertain.

item.title: Trump family-backed crypto firm World Liberty gets conditional bank charter approval
item.description: The OCC conditionally approved World Liberty Trust Co.’s national trust bank charter. That would allow the Trump family-backed firm to issue stablecoins.

item.title: Lala strengthens into a hurricane and bears down on Hawaii’s Big Island with heavy rain, winds
item.description: The Big Island has not experienced a direct hurricane landfall in 155 years.

item.title: How long will software-defined cars last? The auto industry doesn't know yet
item.description: Cars that run on software offer benefits automakers and many customers say older cars cannot compete with. But some analysts worry the vehicles might not last.

item.title: Police looking for additional people who fired guns in Virginia university shooting that wounded 5
item.description: The shooting, just after 1:30 a.m. Saturday, prompted a campus lockdown and came as students were getting ready for the new school year.

item.title: College can cost $100,000 a year. Here's how families are covering the tab
item.description: Because families struggle to pay for school, many students and their parents increasingly depend on federal and private aid to help foot the bill.
